content_metadata.description: A video demonstration of setting up the bed in an Ezytrail Parkes offroad caravan, hosted by Rick "Ricko" O'Brien.

trimmingSuggestions.description: Consider shortening the time spent on opening each catch. A jump cut to the lid already partially open could be used to accelerate the scene.
The jump cut could be moved slightly earlier to show Rick already partially lifting the wall, reducing the static time before the wall is in its final position.
While important for engagement, consider shortening the call to action by using on-screen graphics or annotations to direct viewers to the Facebook page and YouTube channel.
